_doc: Who voices whom (ElevenLabs voice ids). 'clones' are real people who gave permission (nobody else is ever cloned); 'designed' are custom voices made with ElevenLabs Voice Design (scripts/voice-design.py, descriptions in 'designed_desc') and take priority over 'stock' (older library voices, kept as a fallback). 'hold' = not generated yet (waiting on a clone; their Kreddle doubles wait too). Speakers not listed get a pool voice by a stable hash of their name; 'female' picks the pool. Every line renders on eleven_v3 with delivery tags (docs/VOICE_MOODS.md), except that clones in 'v2_neutral' keep eleven_multilingual_v2 for lines with no mood (they sounded less like themselves on v3). 'delivery' is a speaker's default tag when a line has no other mood.

accents._doc: Accent tag put on every v3 line for non-cloned voices that must keep a particular accent.
accents.CHINESE CROBLEY: speaking English with a very strong Chinese accent
accents.GENIE: speaking English with a strong, unmistakable Indian accent
accents.ALL: rowdy pub crowd, broad northern English accents

pronounce._doc: How a word is said aloud (the on-screen text is unchanged). Lines containing it are re-recorded.

tempo._doc: Speed a speaker's clips up (>1) or down after recording, pitch kept. Existing clips are re-timed locally.

pitch._doc: Semitones to shift a speaker's clips by after recording (formants kept). Existing clips are shifted locally, not re-recorded.

keyword_moods._doc: Per-speaker moods picked by what a line says, when it has no explicit, inline or punctuation mood. First match wins.

doubles._doc: Kreddle doppelgangers: same voice as their Krelworld counterpart, American accent (eleven_v3 audio tag).

clone_accents._doc: Accent tag for cloned voices on eleven_v3, which otherwise drift (American, or regional). Everyone in the group is southern English: faint RP or a slight cockney. Default below.

warble._doc: Post-processing on every clip of these speakers (ffmpeg vibrato: frequency Hz, depth 0-1): Gabor's goat tremble.

shout_words._doc: Speakers whose YEE/YEGH in dialogue is the user's own recording (Synth shout bank), not TTS: the word is cut from the recorded line and the game plays the shout in its place (Voice.ts SHOUT_WORDS mirrors this).
